body.summary: A science-fiction novel by the pseudonymous blogger nostalgebraist, serialised online and later self-published. It follows a small cast of humans and non-humans caught up in a hidden cosmic conflict involving beings called the 'angels', who exist in a strange relationship to ordinary space and time, and an organisation that monitors and manages contact with them. The narrative moves between intimate character drama and large-scale metaphysical speculation, with a structure that shifts between viewpoints and timelines. ||The ending resolves the central confrontation in a way that reframes the nature of the angels and the protagonists' place in the larger order.||
